maya: Quick Q — prepping infra review. Where's a single dashboard/panel I can share that shows SM%, GPU mem, KV cache hit rate, and batch size hist for prod-gpu-eu?

raj: Use the 'gpu cluster overview' dash in Grafana. Panel IDs I usually grab: SM util 42, GPU mem 43, KV hit 44, batch hist 47. Dash link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd123/gpu-cluster-overview?var-cluster=prod-gpu-eu

sophie: FYI the KV hit panel defaults to 15m — for a review set to 6h or 24h to catch eviction cycles. If you need per-node, flip var.node.

maya: thx — do we have Prometheus / Loki queries I can paste into the runbook/PR? want reproducible steps.

raj: sure — paste these:
```
# SM% (5m avg)
avg by(pod)(irate(nvidia_gpu_sm_utilization[5m])) * 100
\n# GPU memory % used
sum by(instance)(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) / sum by(instance)(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) * 100
\n# KV cache hit rate (ratio)
sum(kv_cache_hits_total) / sum(kv_cache_hits_total + kv_cache_misses_total)
\n# Batch size distribution (95th)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

# Loki quick filter for KV events
```
{app=~"inference"} |= "kvcache" |~ "evict|miss" | json
```

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-3421 created for alert tuning: prod-gpu-eu KV hit < 0.6 for 10m. CC: @liza

liza: Thanks — I'll own this. Question: alert routing? slack-only first, escalate to ops on-call after 15m persist? Thoughts?

tom: For playbook: if KV hit drops AND SM% > 85% simultaneously, either route traffic to larger-batch nodepool or temporarily reduce max_batch_size on routes. I'll add mitigation steps to the ticket.

maya: Perfect. Can someone paste the exact panel permalink for the batch hist so I can embed it in the PR?

raj: Permalink: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd123/gpu-cluster-overview?panelId=47&viewPanel=47&var-cluster=prod-gpu-eu

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll add the queries to the PR description and ping @prod-owner for visibility.

maya: thanks all — closing loop. ping me if you change alert thresholds or add automated rollbacks. :sparkles:
